{{Quote|Just passing under the Medway Avenue pedwalk, which you can see is raining silver flimsi confetti down on each vehicle in a constant downpour&mdash;ah, I'm given to understand that this is symbolic of tears, this would be the tears of the admiral's non-aquatic mourners, since the natives of Mon Cal do not cry&hellip;|Javis Tyrr, reporting on Cha Niathal's funeral|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''Medway Avenue''' was a street on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|funeral]] procession, which was narrated on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]], passed near the [[pedwalk]], which rained down silver [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsi]], symbolic of tears of mourning for the Admiral's [[Death/Legends|death]].
